messages:
sara: Morning — we need to schedule a design kickoff for the unified client config work (API + SDK + Console UX). Goal: walk the API contract, SDK ergonomics, console flows, and land owners + next steps. Proposing a 45m slot the week of Apr 22. Pre-read pack (short):

1) RFC draft (link in thread)
2) Minimal sample req/resp + error matrix
3) Performance targets and SLOs to validate
4) 'What to test' checklist for QE/Dev

Quick ask: react with :one: / :two: / :three: for preferred slot and reply if you want to present a section. Options: 
:one: Tue 10:00-10:45 PT
:two: Wed 11:00-11:45 PT
:three: Thu 09:00-09:45 PT

I will update the pre-read with the sample req/resp and perf targets after votes.

junaid: +1 — I can present the API section. :one: works best for me. Will add a short example of pagination and error enums to the pre-read.

micah: heads up — Tue morning is tight for me. prefer :two: (Wed 11). Also want a 5m slot to cover canary/rollout constraints.

alina: I'm on-call Tue morning so :two: (Wed 11) or later is better. Happy to take SDK ergonomics.

kevin: I'll join. Please include perf targets and a note about latency SLOs in the pre-read. I can cover the perf validation checklist (5m). :three: is ok but can be flexible.

deploy-bot: :package: Draft canary plan uploaded to https://files.internal/redwood/canary/214365 - includes rollback criteria and smoke test list.

sara: Thanks — noted. Tentative agenda (45m):
- 5m quick context + goals
- 15m API (junaid)
- 15m SDK ergonomics (alina)
- 5m Console UX highlights (sara)
- 5m rollout + action owners (micah/kevin)

I'll update the pre-read with: sample req/resp, error matrix, perf targets, and a short "what to test" pack. If you want more time to present, call it out now. Please react with your top slot (emoji) and add a quick line if you need owner assignment.

junaid: :one: voted and added API sample in the RFC doc. If we need more time for auth edge cases, say so.

micah: :two: voted. I’ll prep the canary notes and rollback scripts. Can we add a slide for observability bits (traces/metrics) — 2m?

alina: :two: voted. I can take SDK + examples. Will add a short snippet showing client builder ergonomics.

kevin: :three: for now but I can move to :two: if that's the final slot. I pushed a short perf checklist to the doc.

sara: Cool — current tally: :one: (junaid), :two: (micah, alina), :three: (kevin). Unless more votes come in I'll book Wed 11:00-11:45 PT and share calendar + pre-read link by EOD tomorrow.

Also: action items before the meeting — please add one-line owner notes in the RFC doc under the "meeting prep" section: who presents, who owns followups, which tests are required. I'll follow up on owners after calendar is up. :thumbsup:
